classification.difficultyReason: Find one ratio part from the tennis group, then calculate the total and swimming group.

content.prompt: Students in a school are told to choose one out of three sports options: tennis, basketball or swimming. Given that the pupils choose the options in the ratio $4:2:3$ and that 120 choose tennis, find:

children.label: a
children.prompt: the number of pupils in the school

answer.worked:
Tennis represents 4 parts. There are $4+2+3=9$ parts altogether.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Pupils in one part}&=120\div4\\\text{Pupils in one part}&=30\\\text{Total pupils}&=9\times30\\\text{Total pupils}&=270\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: the number of students who choose swimming

answer.worked:
Swimming represents 3 parts.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Students in one part}&=120\div4=30\\\text{Students choosing swimming}&=3\times30\\\text{Students choosing swimming}&=90\end{align*}$$
